plainText:
(Japanese: サトシとハルカ！ホウエンでの熱きバトル！！ and ! Heated Battles of Hoenn!!) is the 120th episode of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire, and the 394th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It was first broadcast in Japan on March 24, 2005.

 

==Plot==
In the first Pokémon clip show, and are still on the boat headed towards Slateport City, where aims to win the title of Top Coordinator. In the meantime, Ash and May recollect memories from their together through the Hoenn region.

Having acquired the eight needed Badges to enter the Hoenn League , Ash remembers the Gym s he faced to get to this point, while remembers the Contest Battles that earned her the five Ribbons required to compete in the Hoenn Grand Festival.

==Trivia==
This is the first episode since the very first that Jessie, James, and are absent. This also marks their only absence in Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire.
However, if this episode is excluded, then this title goes to Rematch at the Nacrene Gym!.
The clip show had unedited audio playing with the scenes that utilized clips from prior episodes, similar to the Japanese version of Mewtwo Returns.
's Gym s against Wattson and Flannery are excluded.
's second win is also excluded.
Advance Adventure is used as background music when the narrator talks about May's Contests.
This is the final episode to be skipped in the 4Kids Entertainment dub.
As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan.
This is the first episode to be skipped in all dubs after the worldwide-banned episode EP038.
